findings.source: quaternion-to-C2 identification x0+x1i+x2j+x3k <-> (x0+x1i,x2+x3i), q=z1+z2j, j(z1+z2j)=-bar(z2)+bar(z1)j with source intermediate multiplication steps
findings.defect: The W098 body names multiplication by j but omits exact coordinate-map and anti-conjugate multiplication formulas.

findings.source: CP3 ordinary real map rho([z1,z2,z3,z4])=[bar(z1),bar(z2),bar(z3),bar(z4)]; twistor rho_tw([z1,z2,z3,z4])=[-bar(z2),bar(z1),-bar(z4),bar(z3)]; ordinary real-point locus RP3 of real dimension 3; no rho_tw real points but invariant twistor P1 real lines
findings.defect: W099 omits exact CP3 real-structure formulas, usual-real RP3 locus and fixed-real-line scope separation.

findings.source: HP1 homogeneous quaternion classes [q1,q2], ordered affine quotient q=(q2)^-1 q1, H chart excluding [q1,0], map pi:[z1,z2,z3,z4] in CP3 -> [z1+z2j,z3+z4j] in HP1, quaternionic-line fibers over HP1=S4
findings.defect: W099 names fibration/family but omits source's quotient order, exact map, chart and fiber incidence.

findings.source: only two inequivalent real structures rho and rho_tw on CP3; Minkowski PT reality does not act on PT but maps PT to dual PT*, interchanging chiral spinor roles
findings.defect: W100 conserves the Minkowski contrast but omits explicit two-inequivalent-CP3-real-structures claim.

findings.source: SL(2,C) induces CP1 conformal action from C2, noncommuting with its real structure; SL(2,H)=Spin(5,1) acts on CP3 from H2, again noncommuting
findings.defect: Explicit action/noncommutation, conformal-role and group-representation semantics absent from W100 body (and not stated with these operators elsewhere in census).

findings.source: unit imaginary quaternion x1i+x2j+x3k with x unit parametrizes orthogonal complex structures; R4 x CP1 -> CP1 projection on second factor; real structure identity on R4 and rho_tw on CP1
findings.defect: W101 omits the parameter formula, projection role and factorwise real-structure identity.

findings.source: pi holomorphic for the stated fiberwise complex structure; holomorphic fibration O(1) direct-sum O(1); Pauli matrices x1sigma1+x2sigma2+x3sigma3, +1 eigenspace above x acting on C2 gives O(1), two copies yield O(1)+O(1), R4≈C+C=C2; quaternionic dimension d gives 2d O(1) copies
findings.defect: The W101 summary names O(1) copies but elides source's Pauli/eigenspace generating construction and explicit projection holomorphy.

findings.source: self-dual Yang-Mills solutions on S4 correspond to holomorphic structures on bundles over CP3; extension to self-dual Einstein solutions via Penrose nonlinear graviton
